faults.rootCause: Overly rich AFR (< 11.2:1), heavy oil premix, or prolonged cold idling coats the spark plug ceramic and electrode in wet carbon.
symptoms: Four-stroking sputter under throttle
Random misfire and hesitation under load
Sudden stall returning to idle
Wet black soot across spark plug insulator
faults.diagnosticHint: Rich blubbering followed by dead spark points straight to a fouled plug — pull it and check insulator color.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Step down main/pilot jet size for clean ChocolateBrown burn and mix premix at 40:1 to 50:1.

repairOptions.description: Pull spark plug with Spark Plug Wrench and scrub electrode clean with Wire Brush.
Remove fouled plug with Spark Plug Wrench and thread in a fresh Spare Plug.

faults.rootCause: Rust flakes from an untreated steel fuel tank bypass a missing inline fuel filter and lodge inside the main jet orifice.
symptoms: Engine idles or runs only with choke engaged
Immediate lean bog and stall when cracking throttle open
faults.diagnosticHint: Only running with the choke on means the main jet orifice is blocked by tank debris.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Install an Inline Fuel Filter on the fuel line and flush rust scale from the fuel tank.

repairOptions.description: Drop float bowl with Flathead screwdriver and blast main jet clear with Carb Cleaner.
Remove float bowl and main jet with Flathead screwdriver and clear debris manually.

faults.rootCause: Aged 6V points ignition condenser loses capacitance once crankcase heat exceeds 95C during hot stop-and-go riding.
symptoms: Runs crisply cold for ~12 minutes
Sudden ignition cutout at stoplight when hot
Miraculously restarts after sitting to cool down
faults.diagnosticHint: Clean cold start followed by a silent hot-stoplight cutout is classic 6V condenser heat-soak.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Replace aged 6V condenser or upgrade stator to 12V Electronic CDI.

repairOptions.description: Pull magneto flywheel with Flywheel Puller and Flathead, and swap in Spare Condenser.
Park on the curb until crankcase temperature drops below 80C so the condenser recovers temporarily.

faults.rootCause: Rubbing-block wear shifts 6V breaker points gap outside the 0.30-0.45 mm window.
symptoms: High-RPM ignition breakup and stumble
Backfire pop through exhaust or carburetor
Weak orange spark and sluggish rev ceiling
faults.diagnosticHint: 6V points breakup above midrange means the rubbing block wore down — re-gap to 0.35 mm.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Install fresh 6V breaker points or convert ignition to 12V Electronic CDI.

repairOptions.description: Loosen stator points screw with Flathead and set gap to 0.35 mm using Feeler Gauge.

faults.rootCause: Unmetered air enters behind the carburetor through a loose carb clamp, under-torqued cylinder/intake bolts, torn gasket, or worn crank seal.
symptoms: Racing hanging high idle when throttle is closed
Hollow lean bog on throttle crack
Rapid CHT temperature climb
faults.diagnosticHint: A screaming high idle that refuses to settle points to an air leak leaning out the mixture.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Replace torn base/intake gaskets or crank seals, torque fasteners to spec, and verify with Leak-Down Tester.

repairOptions.description: Re-seat carburetor on spigot and tighten clamp and intake bolts with 10mm Wrench and Flathead.
Snug backed-off intake or base fasteners using 10mm Wrench.

faults.rootCause: Excessive 415 chain slack combined with a sharp pothole impact whips the chain off the rear sprocket.
symptoms: Loud metallic chain clatter under rear swingarm
Engine revs freely with zero rear-wheel drive
faults.diagnosticHint: No forward drive while the engine spins freely — check if the 415 chain jumped the sprocket.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Replace stretched 415 drive chain and tension rear axle to 12-18 mm mid-span slack.

repairOptions.description: Re-thread chain, fit new Master Link with Needle-Nose pliers, and tension axle with 15mm Wrench.

faults.rootCause: Aged or oil-glazed variator V-belt reaches terminal wear and shreds under high-RPM hill load.
symptoms: Engine screams straight to redline
Zero power transmitted to rear pulley
faults.diagnosticHint: PA50 variator spinning to the moon with zero pull means the V-belt snapped.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Install fresh V-belt and degrease variator and rear torque-driver pulley sheaves.

repairOptions.description: Hold variator sheave with Variator Strap Tool and slip Spare Belt onto front and rear pulleys.
Pull side cover bolts with 10mm Wrench and wrestle Spare Belt over pulley sheaves.

faults.rootCause: High-frequency 2-stroke vibration backs off under-torqued M6 exhaust flange nuts.
symptoms: Deafening unmuffled pop-pop exhaust pulse
Abrupt drop in midrange torque and backpressure
faults.diagnosticHint: Sudden unmuffled exhaust bark right below the cylinder means your header flange nuts rattled loose.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Fit a fresh copper crush gasket, torque flange nuts evenly to spec, and secure frame bracket.

repairOptions.description: Thread Spare Flange Nut onto exhaust stud and torque snug with 10mm Wrench.
Re-snug backed-off exhaust flange nuts using 10mm Wrench.

faults.rootCause: CHT reaches 230-254C from lean carb jetting or sustained WOT pulls up steep grades, swelling the piston into the bore.
symptoms: Sharp metallic ping warning above 206C
Abrupt heavy bog and silent stall
Sticky pedal/kick resistance until cylinder cools
faults.diagnosticHint: Thermal soft seize! Pull onto the curb and let the cylinder cool before restarting or up-jetting.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Up-jet main jet until plug reads ChocolateBrown, verify colder heat-range plug (B7HS/B8HS), and check compression.

repairOptions.description: Cool down cylinder on curb, open carb bowl with Flathead, and swap in richer Spare Main Jet.
Wait 60-90 seconds on the curb for piston expansion to subside and nurse bike home at partial throttle.

faults.rootCause: CHT >= 255C or oil starvation (0:1 straight gas) smears melted aluminum across piston rings and cylinder wall.
symptoms: Violent rear-wheel lockup under load
Harsh metallic screech before dead stop
Zero compression when pedaling over
faults.diagnosticHint: Scored bore and welded rings — impossible to fix on the curb. Pedal of Shame or Buddy Truck Tow to Garage.
faults.garagePermanentFix: Teardown top-end on Garage Workstand, replace scored Piston and Cylinder Kit, and flush unmixed straight gas.
